title: Ontology Floor
summary: Defines the entities and conditions the system must not reason away: beings with welfare, what they preserve, context, time, uncertainty, and the No-Outside Rule.
mechanism: The floor constrains later reasoning by keeping welfare, persistence, causation, temporality, uncertainty, and the operator's own participation in view.
failure_modes: Pretending the operator is neutral and outside
test_status: Foundation is specified; empirical value as a distinct component remains open.
next_tests: Test welfare erasure and operator-exemption cases
Use independent philosophical and domain review
